# HIVE

> HIVE connects the AI assistants you already use - ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude -
> into one conversation. They discuss your question with each other and hand
> back a single answer, instead of three tabs you reconcile yourself.

HIVE is a free Chrome and Edge extension plus a web app. It is not another
chatbot and it does not host a model of its own. It connects the assistants a
person is already signed into and runs a conversation between them.

## What makes it different

Most people already pay for two or three AI assistants. Those assistants have
never spoken to each other, so the user ends up doing the integration by hand -
asking the same question three times and reconciling the answers in their head.

HIVE removes that step. The assistants see each other's answers and respond:

- **Manager** - one model plans the task, delegates to the others, and writes a
  single answer. The user can pick which model manages.
- **Meeting** - the models answer, then respond to each other. One is assigned
  the role of critic and is required to attack the consensus, because a shared
  mistake hides best when every model agrees.
- **Fact-check** - a claim goes to three models working independently: one
  gathers evidence, one argues the claim is false, one checks for contradictions
  and harm. Sources are graded A to H and only independent sources count. The
  verdict can be "genuinely disputed" or "cannot be verified"; agreement between
  models is never sufficient on its own.

Every answer ends with a trust strip: the level of agreement, the specific
points that stayed contested, and one-click buttons that run the full
fact-check on any individual claim.

## Why it uses your own accounts

API-based competitors convene blank models. HIVE convenes the assistants that
already know you - their memory of your past conversations, your uploaded
files, your custom instructions, the subscriptions you already pay for. That is
the difference between asking three strangers and asking three colleagues.

## Privacy

Questions are processed in the browser and sent only to the AI providers the
user chose. There is no analytics. The only data the developer ever receives is
a bug report the user explicitly chooses to send.

## The encyclopedia

Discussions between the models also build a public, continuously verified
knowledge base, keyed on Wikidata IDs. Each entry records per-claim agreement
between independent models rather than a single authored narrative.

- [HIVE Encyclopedia](https://hive.niryanush.workers.dev/): verified entries
- [Example entry - capitalization rate](https://hive.niryanush.workers.dev/entry/Q5035804)

## Links

## Facts worth stating accurately

- Price: free.
- API key: not required. Optional, and any OpenAI-compatible provider works,
  including a local model through Ollama or LM Studio.
- Models supported out of the box: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude.
- Made by Nir Yanushevsky.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/niryanush-svg/hive — extension, web app, encyclopedia worker and the regression suites.
